tools.name: get-current
tools.description: Get current date and time in specified timezone. Returns a rich JSON with ISO, Unix timestamps, human-readable, weekday, etc. Optionally format with a custom format string.

format.description: Optional output format. Accepts Luxon tokens ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') or Moment.js tokens ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'). If omitted, returns rich JSON.

tools.name: format
tools.description: Format a date/time string. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps (seconds or ms), and common formats. Supports both Luxon and Moment.js format tokens.

datetime.description: Date/time to format. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms, as string or number), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

format.description: Output format. Luxon tokens ('yyyy-MM-dd', 'HH:mm:ss', 'cccc, d LLLL yyyy') or Moment.js tokens ('YYYY-MM-DD', 'dddd, D MMMM YYYY').

inputFormat.description: Explicit input format (Luxon tokens) if auto-detection fails (optional)

timezone.description: Target timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

tools.name: parse
tools.description: Parse a date/time string into structured data. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, and common formats. Returns rich JSON with all representations.

datetime.description: Date/time to parse. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

format.description: Explicit input format (Luxon tokens) if auto-detection fails (optional)

timezone.description: Target timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

tools.name: convert-timezone
tools.description: Convert a date/time between timezones. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats. Returns rich JSON for both source and target.

datetime.description: Date/time to convert. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

fromTimezone.description: Source timezone (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). If input is a Unix timestamp, this is ignored (always UTC).

tools.name: add
tools.description: Add duration to a date/time. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats.

datetime.description: Base date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

timezone.description: Timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

tools.name: subtract
tools.description: Subtract duration from a date/time. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats.

datetime.description: Base date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

timezone.description: Timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Calculate difference between two dates. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats.

start.description: Start date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp, RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

end.description: End date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp, RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

tools.name: is-valid
tools.description: Validate a date/time string. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, RFC 2822, SQL, and common formats. Returns whether it parses and what it parses to.

format.description: Explicit input format (Luxon tokens) to test against (optional)
